summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundled payload
details: @servicetitan/anvil2@3.9.6 declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs, an obfuscator.io-style script using hex-named identifiers and inline string-property dispatch objects. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it, chmods the binary executable, and invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB opaque bundle (sha256 9fc2570b7cef51c1b8df116d144d11ff4096357be7d2c4c6367cfc2509cf1bcc) marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` and using shuffled string-array + rotation obfuscation; it is not referenced by the package's declared main (dist/index.js) or any other export and exists only to be executed by the preinstall dropper via the freshly-downloaded Bun runtime. Installing the package causes an obfuscated payload to run under an alien runtime that bypasses Node-based scanners, a pattern with no legitimate justification for a React UI component library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
